intro: Muse uses its own tools and permissions. Paperclip coordinates company tasks and questions. Provider usage and cost are unavailable.
disabled: Muse is disabled in experimental settings. Connection cleanup and stop evidence remain available.
publicOriginRequired: An authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL is required to connect Muse.
disconnected: Disconnected. Paperclip credentials and execution authority were revoked.
detectorRemovalRequested: Detector removal requested; completion is not confirmed.
afterDisconnect: After disconnect, the receiver disables itself when it next reaches Paperclip. Cleanup cannot be confirmed through the revoked connection.
separateSteps: Detector removal, worker stopping, and sandbox cleanup are separate. Paperclip cannot verify every private Muse tool or stop all personal Muse conversations.
nativeEffectsUnknown: Native effect outcomes remain unknown and block replacement work. Worker attestation does not resolve or replay those effects.
stopRevisionUnavailable: Stop binding revision is unavailable. Refresh to inspect this assignment before attesting.
recordExactDetector: Record an observation of this exact detector
digestHint: Use the digest of the secret-free runtime observation. Do not paste the listing, a URL, credentials, or private tool output.
observedAtHint: Enter the actual runtime listing time, not the time you submit this form. Paperclip checks it against revocation and the qualification deadline.
detectorConfirm: I observed this exact hook absent in the supported runtime listing after revocation. This attests detector removal only, not worker stopping or private effects.
confirmWorkerTitle: Confirm the worker for this exact assignment stopped
workerConfirm: I have stopped this Muse worker for the named assignment and run. This does not certify independent private tools or unknown native effects.
saveFirst: Save the agent, then connect your personal Muse here.
accountUnconfirmed: Unable to confirm your account. Refresh to inspect this Muse connection.
contactLag: Receiver contact is persisted in batches and may lag by up to {{seconds}} seconds. Public receiver checks are unverified. Only an authenticated reply confirms Muse can work.
recorded: Recorded {{time}}: {{source}}. This is not independent provider confirmation.

evidence.operator: operator attestation from a supported runtime hook listing

stop.operatorAttested: You attested that this assignment’s Muse worker stopped.
stop.workerReported: Muse reported that this assignment’s worker is quiescent. Independent private effects remain unconfirmed.
stop.fenced: Paperclip fenced this assignment’s authority. Its external stop cannot be confirmed.

hooksHint.after: after revocation to verify this exact registered script is absent. Disabled checks, silence, or a removal request are insufficient. The retained hook ID and observation are your report. Paperclip does not verify installation, query Muse, or remove the hook.

setupDescription: Paste into your current Muse conversation. Complete Connect Paperclip if Muse asks, then approve the Paperclip hostname.
setupExpires: One-use setup expires {{date}}. Muse keeps the connection credential in its secure vault. Hostname permission applies to future requests to this Paperclip hostname.
loadFailed: Unable to load the Muse connection.
